cost: O(file bytes + prior-state rows + staged rows + sum candidate-vector scans) expected Rust work; memory retains complete Doc/state and staged buffers. Repeated duplicate document keys can cause quadratic suffix probing. Database query/transaction and annotation gate costs remain additive and unmeasured.
forward: load_file canonicalizes, reads/hash/parses, rejects empty sentences, queries state, then skips identical path/hash or rejects changed path. Run reuse/new IDs precede six TSV writers. For each sentence, prior-state candidates require sent_id and text equality; Auto/Existing accept exactly one, reject ties, Existing rejects zero, New creates. New document keys track newdoc/file/idprefix policy; repeated newdoc IDs gain ~n. Gate failures are stored as labels. Six flushed tables execute in SQL then counts reconcile.
inverse: Same canonical path with changed SHA1 cannot reach write execution. Ambiguous exact sentence candidates cannot be arbitrarily tie-broken by Auto/Existing. A non-ok annotation gate does not exclude the load: it is counted and staged.

Given report counts and resulting raw rows, antecedents include all prior maxima and run/doc maps consistent with new IDs, all matching candidates producing chosen sids, and source text with matching stored comments/blank metadata. Counts alone cannot recover match identities, original bytes or unused state.

Let m=count prior entries with matching id and text. Existing succeeds only m=1; Auto creates at m=0 and errors m>1; New creates regardless. Newly staged equal sentences do not change m. SQL uniqueness/races remain assumptions.

NewDoc advances current key on newdoc comments before sentence matching; repeated keys within this file gain ~2,~3. Existing matched sentences retain their DB doc even when a new current key was opened.

comment_kv splits literal space-equals-space or trailing space-equals; absent value and present empty string remain different. Raw annotation comments preserve duplicate/order information that metadata JSON maps can overwrite.

TSV validation and ambiguity errors precede exec; post.tsv parsing/count mismatch follows exec and may report error after committed effects. The two phases must not be modeled as one rollback guarantee.
limitations: Finite helper/fixture evidence only; no DuckDB integration or SQL semantics
Partial syntax projection; no macro expansion or full semantic proof

state: rep.created+rep.matched=rep.sents on success. Every staged annotation has one aid and ten raw columns per row. Matching uses the pre-load snapshot: newly staged sentences do not become candidates. Unchecked i64 IDs, ord/para and usize conversions require representable bounds; exhaustion behavior is not a checked error contract.
